[SWS_CM_11375] Link loss on Client side
⌈
In case the SOME/IP network binding
detects a link loss on the client side, the SOME/IP service discovery shall enter the
Down Phase and re-enter into Initial Wait Phase when the link is up again and the
service is still requested (see [PRS_SOMEIPSD_00752]).
⌋
